results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed the sliding_window function in toolz/itertoolz.py by changing the slice index from i+1 to i in the deque creation. This ensures that the first window starts at the first element. The tests now pass.

results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py to handle cases where the requested tail size is larger than the iterable length by clamping the start index to 0. This resolves the ValueError when size - n is negative. All tests pass, including the specific TailTests.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the naturalsize function to use base 1000 for decimal mode (when binary=False and gnu=False) instead of incorrectly using base 1024. results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Fixed swapped ends_with and starts_with functions in jmespath/functions.py. The _func_ends_with was using startswith and _func_starts_with was using endswith. Corrected them to use the appropriate string methods. All compliance tests for functions now pass.

results.name: click-intrange-clamp
results.summary: Fixed the IntRange clamping logic for open bounds: changed _clamp method in _NumberRangeBase to add direction instead of subtract when bound is open. results.name: jinja-batch-filter
results.summary: Fixed the batch filter in src/jinja2/filters.py by changing the condition from `if len(tmp) > linecount:` to `if len(tmp) == linecount:` in the do_batch function. results.name: packaging-canonicalize
results.summary: Fixed canonicalize_name to replace '.' with '-' in addition to '_' before condensing repeats, as required by PEP 503. Verified that the tests pass and the function now correctly normalizes names like 'oslo.concurrency' to 'oslo-concurrency'.

results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed the parsing of \\uXXXX escapes in basic strings by changing the hex length from 3 to 4 in parse_basic_str_escape. All tests now pass.
